title: Salted Chocolate Fudge
description: Rich, bittersweet fudge made from salted butter, dark chocolate chips and condensed milk. Makes a great gift wrapped in baking paper.

ingredients.text: 360g dark chocolate chips or chopped chocolate
1 x 397ml tin of sweetened condensed milk

steps: Put the butter and chocolate chips in a heatproof bowl. Microwave for 2 minutes on high, stirring every 30 seconds, until melted.
Pour in the condensed milk and heat for another 2 minutes, stirring halfway. Stir the thick mixture thoroughly.
Line a 25cm square baking tray with aluminium foil and pour in the fudge. Refrigerate for 3–4 hours to set.
Cut into small squares. Store in an airtight tin for up to a week.
notes: Makes around 40 pieces. Per piece estimate. Sprinkle sea salt over the top for extra saltiness.
